passages.text: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a priest and the son of Buzi.
He lived among the exiles from Judah.
He was by the River Kebar in the land of the Chaldeans.
It was the thirtieth year.
It was the fifth day of the fourth month.
The heavens opened.
I saw visions from God.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽרְבִיעִי֙ בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ וַאֲנִ֥י בְתֽוֹךְ־ הַגּוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר נִפְתְּחוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וָאֶרְאֶ֖ה מַרְא֥וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin— the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
passages.sermon:
This happened on the fifth day of the month.
It was the fifth year since King Jehoiachin went into exile.
Ezekiel was a priest.
Ezekiel was the son of Buzi.
Ezekiel was in the land of the Chaldeans.
He was by the River Kebar.
The word of the LORD came to Ezekiel there.
The LORD’s hand was upon Ezekiel at that place.
passages.original: בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הִ֚יא הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֔ית לְגָל֖וּת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹיָכִֽין׃ הָיֹ֣ה הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־ יְ֠הוָה אֶל־ יְחֶזְקֵ֨אל בֶּן־ בּוּזִ֧י הַכֹּהֵ֛ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים עַל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֛יו שָׁ֖ם יַד־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber, and within it was the form of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: They had a human form, but each had four faces and four wings.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a priest and a prophet.
He was among the exiles by the River Kebar in the land of the Chaldeans.
God gave Ezekiel a vision.
I looked.
I saw a strong windstorm coming from the north.
A large cloud came with it.
Fire flashed back and forth inside the cloud.
Bright light surrounded the cloud.
In the middle of the fire, I saw something that looked like glowing metal.
Inside the fire, I saw four living creatures.
Each creature had a human shape.
Each creature had four faces.
Each creature had four wings.
passages.original: וָאֵ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ סְעָרָ֜ה בָּאָ֣ה מִן־ הַצָּפ֗וֹן עָנָ֤ן גָּדוֹל֙ וְאֵ֣שׁ מִתְלַקַּ֔חַת וְנֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖וֹ סָבִ֑יב וּמִ֨תּוֹכָ֔הּ כְּעֵ֥ין הַחַשְׁמַ֖ל מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃ וּמִ֨תּוֹכָ֔הּ דְּמ֖וּת אַרְבַּ֣ע חַיּ֑וֹת וְזֶה֙ מַרְאֵֽיהֶ֔ן דְּמ֥וּת אָדָ֖ם לָהֵֽנָּה׃ וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְאֶחָ֑ת וְאַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאַחַ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
passages.sermon:
The four living creatures appeared in Ezekiel’s vision.
Each creature had legs.
Their legs were straight.
The soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf.
Their feet gleamed.
Their feet shone like polished bronze.
passages.original: וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם רֶ֣גֶל יְשָׁרָ֑ה וְכַ֣ף רַגְלֵיהֶ֗ם כְּכַף֙ רֶ֣גֶל עֵ֔גֶל וְנֹ֣צְצִ֔ים כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֥שֶׁת קָלָֽל׃

passages.text: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings, and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
passages.sermon:
Four living creatures appeared in Ezekiel’s vision.
Each creature had four sides.
Under their wings on all four sides, they had human hands.
Each creature had faces and wings.
Their wings touched the wings of the other creatures.
The creatures did not turn as they moved.
Each creature went straight ahead.
passages.original: וְיָדוֹ אָדָ֗ם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רִבְעֵיהֶ֑ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֖ם לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽם׃ חֹֽבְרֹ֛ת אִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־ אֲחוֹתָ֖הּ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֑ם לֹא־ יִסַּ֣בּוּ בְלֶכְתָּ֔ן אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵֽכוּ׃

passages.text: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
passages.sermon:
The four living creatures each had four faces.
Each creature had a human face.
Each creature had a lion’s face on the right side.
Each creature had an ox’s face on the left side.
Each creature also had an eagle’s face.
passages.original: וּדְמ֣וּת פְּנֵיהֶם֮ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָם֒ וּפְנֵ֨י אַרְיֵ֤ה אֶל־ הַיָּמִין֙ לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֔ם וּפְנֵי־ שׁ֥וֹר מֵֽהַשְּׂמֹ֖אול לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ן וּפְנֵי־ נֶ֖שֶׁר לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃

passages.text: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
passages.sermon:
The four living creatures had faces and wings.
Their faces looked like a man, a lion, an ox, and an eagle.
Their wings spread upward.
Each creature had two wings that touched the wings of the creature next to it.
Each creature had two wings that covered its own body.
passages.original: וּפְנֵיהֶ֕ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֥ם פְּרֻד֖וֹת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה לְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁ֚תַּיִם חֹבְר֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם מְכַסּ֔וֹת אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹתֵיהֶֽנָה׃

passages.text: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
passages.sermon:
The living creatures each moved straight ahead.
They did not turn as they moved.
The spirit led them.
Wherever the spirit wanted to go, the creatures went.
They always followed the spirit’s direction.
passages.original: וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵ֑כוּ אֶ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה־ שָׁ֨מָּה הָר֤וּחַ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃

passages.text: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
passages.sermon:
The living creatures appeared in the vision of Ezekiel.
They looked like burning coals of fire.
They also looked like torches.
Fire moved among the living creatures.
The fire was bright.
Lightning came out from the fire.
passages.original: וּדְמ֨וּת הַחַיּ֜וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶ֣ם כְּגַחֲלֵי־ אֵ֗שׁ בֹּֽעֲרוֹת֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלַּפִּדִ֔ים הִ֕יא מִתְהַלֶּ֖כֶת בֵּ֣ין הַחַיּ֑וֹת וְנֹ֣גַהּ לָאֵ֔שׁ וּמִן־ הָאֵ֖שׁ יוֹצֵ֥א בָרָֽק׃

passages.text: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
passages.sermon: The living creatures moved very quickly.\r\nThey darted back and forth.\r\nThey moved as fast as lightning flashes.
passages.original: וְהַחַיּ֖וֹת רָצ֣וֹא וָשׁ֑וֹב כְּמַרְאֵ֖ה הַבָּזָֽק׃

passages.text: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Ezekiel saw four living creatures.
Each living creature had four faces.
Ezekiel looked at the living creatures.
He saw a wheel on the ground.
The wheel was beside each living creature.
Each wheel was next to a creature with four faces.
passages.original: וָאֵ֖רֶא הַחַיּ֑וֹת וְהִנֵּה֩ אוֹפַ֨ן אֶחָ֥ד בָּאָ֛רֶץ אֵ֥צֶל הַחַיּ֖וֹת לְאַרְבַּ֥עַת פָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
passages.sermon:
The wheels appeared bright and shining.
They looked like beryl stone.
All four wheels looked the same.
Each wheel had the same shape.
Each wheel looked like a wheel inside another wheel.
passages.original: מַרְאֵ֨ה הָאוֹפַנִּ֤ים וּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ כְּעֵ֣ין תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ וּדְמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ן וּמַרְאֵיהֶם֙ וּמַ֣עֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָאוֹפַ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃

passages.text: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
passages.sermon: The wheels moved as the living creatures moved.\r\nThe wheels could go in any of the four directions.\r\nThe wheels did not turn as they moved.
passages.original: עַל־ אַרְבַּ֥עַת רִבְעֵיהֶ֖ן בְּלֶכְתָּ֣ם יֵלֵ֑כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃

passages.text: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
passages.sermon:
The wheels had rims.
The rims were very high.
The rims looked awesome.
Each rim was full of eyes.
All four rims had eyes all around.
passages.original: וְגַ֨בֵּיהֶ֔ן וְגֹ֥בַהּ לָהֶ֖ם וְיִרְאָ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם וְגַבֹּתָ֗ם מְלֵאֹ֥ת עֵינַ֛יִם סָבִ֖יב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃

passages.text: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
passages.sermon: The living creatures moved.\r\nThe wheels moved beside the living creatures.\r\nWhen the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
passages.original: וּבְלֶ֙כֶת֙ הַֽחַיּ֔וֹת יֵלְכ֥וּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וּבְהִנָּשֵׂ֤א הַֽחַיּוֹת֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֖וּ הָאוֹפַנִּֽים׃

passages.text: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
passages.sermon:
The living creatures had a spirit inside them.
The spirit guided the living creatures.
Wherever the spirit wanted to go, the living creatures went.
The wheels moved together with the living creatures.
The wheels rose up when the living creatures rose up.
The spirit of the living creatures was inside the wheels.
passages.original: עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה־ שָּׁ֨ם הָר֤וּחַ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ שָׁ֥מָּה הָר֖וּחַ לָלֶ֑כֶת וְהָאוֹפַנִּ֗ים יִנָּשְׂאוּ֙ לְעֻמָּתָ֔ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּאוֹפַנִּֽים׃

passages.text: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
passages.sermon:
The living creatures moved.
The wheels moved with them.
The living creatures stood still.
The wheels stood still with them.
The living creatures rose from the ground.
The wheels rose alongside them.
The spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
passages.original: בְּלֶכְתָּ֣ם יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּבְעָמְדָ֖ם יַֽעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּֽבְהִנָּשְׂאָ֞ם מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֗רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֤וּ הָאֽוֹפַנִּים֙ לְעֻמָּתָ֔ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּאוֹפַנִּֽים׃

passages.text: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
passages.sermon:
The living creatures appeared in Ezekiel’s vision.
Above the heads of these living creatures, something spread out.
This thing looked like an expanse.
The expanse shone and gleamed.
It looked like crystal.
The expanse stretched out over their heads from above.
The expanse looked awesome and wonderful.
passages.original: וּדְמ֞וּת עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֤י הַחַיָּה֙ רָקִ֔יעַ כְּעֵ֖ין הַקֶּ֣רַח הַנּוֹרָ֑א נָט֥וּי עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
passages.sermon:
The living creatures stood under the expanse.
Their wings stretched out toward each other.
Each creature had two wings that covered its body.
Each creature had two more wings that also covered its body.
passages.original: וְתַ֙חַת֙ הָרָקִ֔יעַ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֣ם יְשָׁר֔וֹת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחוֹתָ֑הּ לְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָהֵ֔נָּה וּלְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָהֵ֔נָּה אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw four living creatures.
These creatures had wings.
When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings.
Their wings sounded like the roar of many waters.
Their wings sounded like the voice of the Almighty.
Their wings sounded like the noise of a great army.
When the creatures stood still, they lowered their wings.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ ק֣וֹל כַּנְפֵיהֶ֡ם כְּקוֹל֩ מַ֨יִם רַבִּ֤ים כְּקוֹל־ שַׁדַּי֙ בְּלֶכְתָּ֔ם ק֥וֹל הֲמֻלָּ֖ה כְּק֣וֹל מַחֲנֶ֑ה בְּעָמְדָ֖ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw living creatures.
These creatures had wings.
There was an expanse above their heads.
A voice came from above the expanse.
The voice was above their heads.
The creatures stood still.
They lowered their wings.
passages.original: וַיְהִי־ ק֕וֹל מֵעַ֕ל לָרָקִ֖יעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֑ם בְּעָמְדָ֖ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw four living creatures.
Above the heads of these creatures was an expanse.
Above this expanse was something that looked like a throne.
The throne looked like it was made of sapphire.
On the throne was a figure.
The figure looked like a man.
The figure sat high above the living creatures.
passages.original: וּמִמַּ֗עַל לָרָקִ֙יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אֶֽבֶן־ סַפִּ֖יר דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א וְעַל֙ דְּמ֣וּת הַכִּסֵּ֔א דְּמ֞וּת כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֛ם עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw a figure on a throne above the expanse.
This figure looked like a man.
From His waist upward, Ezekiel saw something that gleamed like amber.
Fire appeared inside it and all around it.
From His waist downward, Ezekiel saw what looked like fire.
Brilliant light surrounded Him.
passages.original: וָאֵ֣רֶא׀ כְּעֵ֣ין חַשְׁמַ֗ל כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֤שׁ בֵּֽית־ לָהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֖יו וּלְמָ֑עְלָה וּמִמַּרְאֵ֤ה מָתְנָיו֙ וּלְמַ֔טָּה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֔שׁ וְנֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
passages.sermon:
God appeared to Ezekiel in a vision.
God’s glory shone with brilliant light all around Him.
This light looked like a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day.
This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD.
Ezekiel saw this vision.
Ezekiel fell facedown.
Ezekiel heard a voice speaking.
passages.original: כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַקֶּ֡שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בֶעָנָ֜ן בְּי֣וֹם הַגֶּ֗שֶׁם כֵּ֣ן מַרְאֵ֤ה הַנֹּ֙גַהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב ה֕וּא מַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כְּבוֹד־ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽאֶרְאֶה֙ וָאֶפֹּ֣ל עַל־ פָּנַ֔י וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע ק֥וֹל מְדַבֵּֽר׃ס
